real operating conditions
tech_features.subtitle: Measurement principles, maintainable structures and field-control signals are connected as one practical operating system.

items.title: Continuous Rotating Electrode
items.description: The rotating structure helps limit electrode fouling and measures residual chlorine continuously without a membrane.

items.title: 90° Low-Range Scattered Light
items.description: A detachable bubble-reduction structure and scattered-light detection help limit microbubble interference.

items.title: Integrated Display, Calibration and Output
items.description: The WBSC10 manages local display, calibration, 4–20 mA output and RS-485 communication in one controller.

product_highlight.title: Online Instrumentation
product_highlight.subtitle: Waterbee controllers and sensors connected as one operating system

applications.title: Smart Filter-Drain System
applications.subtitle: Precision filtration, upstream and downstream water-quality monitoring, and automatic drain control configured for site pipe size and operating conditions.

items.title: Precision Filtration
items.description: Select 10 / 50 / 100 μm filtration to match the operating condition.

items.title: Pre/Post Water Monitoring
items.description: Configure turbidity and residual chlorine instruments for the operating objective.

items.title: Automatic Drain Control
items.description: PLC/HMI and supervisory systems control draining according to operating conditions.
